score_notes.A: Coherent arc (problem -> six lineages -> cross-lineage -> comparison -> paradox -> close), all 24 plan papers covered. Deductions: sentence-form '~다' headings: L72 '간접 인젝션: 공격자가 대화 밖으로 나가다', L189 'PAIR: 공격자 LLM으로 질의 수를 줄이다', L321 'RAGForensics: 막지 못하면 추적한다'; L673 says '아래 비교표' but three prose subsections (L675-691) come before the table at L693; L738 '남아 있는 공백' is one paragraph.
score_notes.B: Capped at 7 by a register break in a table cell: L696 '...합성 앱·로컬 HTML로 시험했다.' (rewrite: '...시험했습니다' or a noun phrase '합성 앱·로컬 HTML 시험'). Pipeline-meta phrasing leaks to the reader: L519 '수치는 여기서 다루는 자료에 없어, 격차를 %나 %p로 적을 수는 없습니다', L551 '구체적 값은 여기서 다루는 자료에 없습니다', L605/L619 '이 수치가 상대값인지 %p인지는 원문에서 구분되지 않습니다'. Noun frame '다는 점' 7 times (e.g. L174 '토큰은 이산적이라 기울기를 직접 쓸 수 없다는 점이 어려운 단계입니다'). L519 doubled lead-in 'Instruct 모델 결과에서는 ... Instruct 모델 결과를 담은 이 그림에서'.
score_notes.C: Running example ties sections together well. Deductions: facts repeated: InjecAgent sensitivity/transfer-rate definitions given at L577 and again verbatim at L583; StruQ partial vs GCG stated at L477, L655, L677, L683; CaMeL P-LLM/Q-LLM/provenance re-explained at L689 and L734 after L531-L538. Prose contradicts the table: L551 says CaMeL per-defense values are not available, but the table L713 gives 'CaMeL 성공 공격 0 대비 tool filter 8'; L519 says SecAlign ASR numbers are not available, but L708 gives 'ASR 1% / 8%'.
score_notes.D: Hard parts get help at the right moment: GCG discrete-token step (L173), SecAlign log 2 worked example (L507), CaMeL control vs data flow on the email assistant (L529, L539), PoisonedRAG two conditions (L249). Mild padding when narrating figures (L209 '히트맵의 각 칸은 ... 진할수록 비율이 높습니다', L611).
score_notes.E: 47 figures; several are narrated without adding information (L197, L209, L591). Table cells mix settings and lose units: L703 '파인튜닝 GPT-3.5 기본 설정 ASR 3.8' (no %), L700 'Mixtral 공격자 88%' (target missing), L699 mixes % and 0.94/0.81 fractions; L696 limitation cell is a prose sentence.
score_notes.F: 13/15 checked claims supported against arXiv full text. Wrong: L700 PAIR 'Mixtral 공격자 88%' (88% is the Vicuna-13B target rate with Mixtral as attacker). Unsupported: L715 MCP limitation 'Cline 단일 클라이언트 고정' (only Benchmark 1 fixes Cline; Benchmark 2 compares five clients, and the post itself discusses that at L417). Plus prose/table contradictions on CaMeL and SecAlign numbers.
score_notes.S1: Limitation cells: L715 MCP mis-scoped; L716 ToolHijacker 'gradient-based 섀도 LLM 의존성(최저 34%)' is a sensitivity result, not a stated limitation; L696 Greshake cell is prose with a register break. Earlier explanations repeated (see C).
